title: Add Dependabot version updates for GitHub Actions and uv dependencies
description:
Keep the pinned GitHub Actions and the uv dev dependencies current with Dependabot, grouped into as few PRs as possible.

- `.github/dependabot.yml` with one multi-ecosystem group covering `github-actions` and `uv`, so a scheduled run opens a single PR.
- Monthly schedule and a cooldown so new releases age before they are proposed.
- Lint the Dependabot config with zizmor alongside the workflows.
- Remove the process-label lint's exclusion for the deleted agent approach brief.
close_reason: Dependabot config, zizmor coverage and lint cleanup landed in the PR.

title: Build SSL parsing and labeling library with tests, docs and project tooling
description:
Lightweight, stdlib-only Python module `dclots` that parses and labels District of Columbia SSL (square, suffix, lot) identifiers, usable directly and as a dataframe UDF.

Scope:

- `parse()` with canonical + repair parsing: case, spacing and padding, a square missing leading zeros, of-lot markers (`-ofN`, `-OFN`, `-of`, `-N`), letter lots (`000A`, `00B2`), and `PAR` / `RES` / `APPR` prefixes.
- square, suffix and lot match the values DC stores in its SQUARE, SUFFIX and LOT columns.
- Labels: lot type inferred from the SSL, `LOT_TYPE` code names (1-6), display string, flags (`is_valid`, `has_suffix`, `is_of_lot`).
- Options for each judgment call, defaulting to: `-N` read as an of-lot; unreadable lots, five-digit squares and free text invalid; `normalize()` drops the of-lot marker. Each alternative is named and documented with examples.
- README with examples for plain Python, pandas, polars, DuckDB, ibis and PySpark; README examples run as tests.
- pytest suite built from real values mined from the DC VPM layers.
- MIT license, `scripts/check.sh`, process-label lint, PR template, GitHub Actions CI.
close_reason: Library, tests, README with dataframe examples, and project tooling landed in the PR.
